name: phase29b_research_director
objective: Identify bounded, point-in-time-safe FEATURE hypotheses that could materially improve cross-sectional rank-IC stability beyond the exhausted fundamental/momentum blend family. The Phase 29A.3 campaign proved that no portfolio-level knob (blend weight, book size, sector treatment, exit buffer, or their combinations) moves monthly rank-IC; only signal-level construction can. Hypotheses must be expressed in the strict declarative feature DSL over owned point-in-time fields, and every proposal must carry a falsification condition and an explicit leakage analysis.

primary_target.notes: the strict shadow gate requires rank-IC t evidence (2.0 standard) that the current signal set cannot supply (baseline t ~0.79, retained candidates 0.61-1.03)

secondary_constraints: preserve positive cost-adjusted SPY excess across the 12.5/25/50 bps ladder
avoid excessive turnover (do not degrade materially vs the baseline)
avoid sector concentration (the hard gate that killed 40/59 Phase 29A.3 cells)
retain subperiod and regime stability (no single-subperiod artifacts)
do not degrade max drawdown materially

exhausted_dimensions.evidence: simple 30/70 through 70/30 blend changes are exhausted (Phase 29A.3, 59/59 cells, 0 shadow-eligible)
Top-25 versus Top-50 alone is exhausted; Top-50 rejected on materially worse net excess
raw/capped/neutral alone is exhausted; raw and sector_neutral breach the sector_concentration hard gate
0% versus 20% buffer alone is exhausted; the buffer improves turnover but adds no alpha
every direct combination already covered by the Phase 29A.3 59-cell grid is exhausted

safety.notes: the director layer has no challenger-registration capability at all; registration belongs to the deterministic campaign controller behind the strict, unlowered SHADOW_ELIGIBLE gates plus explicit human approval
